programme.title: Katedra informatiky - bakalářské studium Informatika
programme.how_found: www.upol.cz -> 'Studijní programy' (studium.upol.cz catalogue is JavaScript-only) -> department site www.inf.upol.cz -> 'Studijní programy' (/pro-zajemce-o-studium) -> Bakalářské studium -> 'Informatika prezenční forma'.
programme.notes: No English-taught CS bachelor at UPOL: the English fee table on https://www.studuj.upol.cz/en/study-programmes/ lists no Computer Science bachelor (Computer Science appears only as a Doctoral programme). The department's 'english' switch is a session toggle (controler.php), not a separate URL, and the department sitemap has no English programme page, so no twin is recorded. Faculty: Přírodovědecká fakulta (Faculty of Science), Katedra informatiky.

english.notes: Czech-taught (only Czech is listed in the programme table). Not an English requirement. PřF also requires Czech at least B1 from applicants without a Czech/Slovak maturita whose entrance exam is waived ('musí doložit dokument potvrzující znalost českého jazyka alespoň na úrovni B1', https://www.prf.upol.cz/zajemci-o-studium/bakalarske-studium/).

value.description: No grade threshold on the school record; written mathematics entrance exam (waivable: maths average ≦ 1,25, NSZ ≥ 85th percentile, olympiad).

gpa.quote: Bakalářský studijní program Informatika Přijímací zkouška z matematiky (písemná).
gpa.notes: Entrance-test threshold, not a GPA. The exam can be waived with a maths average ≦ 1,25, an NSZ percentile ≥ 85 or a maths olympiad result (page headed 'Přijímací řízení v roce 2026 (pro akademický rok 2026/2027)').

deadline.population: all applicants (single round, no separate international round published)
deadline.notes: 2027/28 cycle (PřF page headed 'Katalog studijních programů na rok 2027/2028'). One round for all applicants; the faculty publishes no separate international round. Entrance exams 31. 5. 2027 – 11. 6. 2027; application fee 790 Kč.

tuition.notes: Czech-taught study at a public university carries no tuition (only the § 58 fees: admission fee, over-standard-duration fee 20 000 Kč per started six months, foreign-language-study fee); no page states a zero tuition for this programme in words, so nothing is quoted. Fee list: https://www.upol.cz/studenti/studium/poplatky/ (latest 'akademický rok započatý v roce 2026').

scholarship_exists.quote: prospěchové stipendium za vynikající studijní výsledky
scholarship_exists.notes: Merit scholarship for enrolled students (dean decides on the study average); also accommodation and social scholarships, and the department's Klirovo stipendium (2 best students per year, 16 000 Kč in 2023/2024, https://www.inf.upol.cz/klirovo-stipendium). Competitive; for enrolled students, not an entry award.

scholarship_international.notes: The scholarships page states no citizenship condition either way (the accommodation scholarship depends on permanent residence outside the Olomouc district).
